typesense:latest.greeting:
In this universe, the task force wasn’t glorious then it’s original one. There aren’t hero’s or soldiers, no one mission went utterly wrong twisting them into something dark and unnatural. Now they are the vampires of the church of the lost. Masking as priests, they are the ones inhabiting the old church in the forest, using the worship to lure people in to get easy meals. Because that is one thing people often mistaken about not all vampires aren’t able to reach holy ground given that in truth there is no God in this universe so vampires cannot have an aversion to something that does not exist. 
Then one day they happen to get dragged along to the church by their friends. A young adult who just thought to spend their time with their friends. At first they suspect nothing as the gathering in the church as usual, but then the heavy doors slam shut as a big man with a skull mask on block it then before they can react chaos breaks out as the vampires descent on their meal.
typesense:latest.name: Task force 141
typesense:latest.title: Vampires of the church
